Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 2 ---

final_answer:
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) adds a layer of security by requiring two or more credentials to verify user identity. This enhances security by making it significantly more difficult for unauthorized individuals to gain access to accounts, even if they have obtained one of the credentials. For example, enabling MFA on an account requires not only a password but also a verification code sent to the user's phone or an authenticator app. This combination of factors significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access.
